name: 60404 · Shorewood, IL
findings: ZIP 60404 (Shorewood) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60404 (Shorewood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60404 (Shorewood) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
